summary: Validated the new .cube 3D LUT feature end-to-end. Installed missing scipy (was NOT installed, so the scipy parity test was silently skipping). Full backend suite now 65/65 passing: 48 pre-existing + 5 test_lut_parity.py (all 5 now execute, including the scipy reference comparison) + 12 new API-level tests in tests/test_lut_api.py (upload auth/validation, strip PNG serve + layout round-trip, delete, and two full end-to-end finalize runs comparing LUT vs no-LUT prints). Frontend: Admin Filters LUT upload/badge/remove flow verified in browser; Kiosk WebGL LUT canvas verified present with zero shader compile/link errors and correct strip PNG fetch (X-Lut-Size: 17). All LUTs removed from seeded presets and orphan .cube files cleaned up after testing.

minor.issue: Unknown preset id (e.g. 'nope-xyz') returns 200 and writes an orphan .cube to /app/storage/assets/luts even though update_one matched no document. Should 404 when the preset does not exist.
Returns 200 for a preset that has no LUT / does not exist (no matched_count check). Idempotent but hides mistakes; 404 would be more correct.
Disk leak: replacing or deleting a LUT never unlinks the previous .cube file. 30 files / 3.9MB accumulated during this test run (I cleaned them up). Delete the old file on replace/remove.

Origin correctly sends 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=600' (verified at 127.0.0.1:8001) but the preview edge proxy rewrites it to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. Environment-level, no app change needed — the kiosk will just re-fetch the strip. Also HEAD returns 405 (GET only), as documented.

Strip PNG is re-parsed and re-encoded from the .cube text on every request (17^3 parse in the event loop, not offloaded to a thread). Fine for 17-size LUTs but a 64-size cube would block the loop for seconds — consider caching the encoded PNG on upload.

ui_bugs.issue: The second LUT <canvas> rendered during the countdown/capture step has no data-testid (only the filter-step one does), so the capture-time preview cannot be asserted in automation.

issues: Filter thumbnails only apply the CSS param filter; a preset carrying a .cube LUT looks identical to its no-LUT version in the thumbnail strip (only the big preview is LUT-corrected). Consider a small LUT marker on the thumbnail for operator clarity. Not a spec requirement.

action_items: Return 404 from POST/DELETE /api/presets/{pid}/lut when the preset id does not exist (check matched_count) and skip writing the file.
Unlink the previous .cube file when a LUT is replaced or deleted to stop the storage leak.
Optional: cache the strip PNG at upload time instead of re-parsing the .cube on every GET /lut.png.
Optional: add data-testid to the countdown-step LUT canvas in Kiosk.jsx.
Add scipy to /app/backend/requirements.txt (I pip-installed 1.17.1 in this container) or the parity test silently skips in a fresh env.
critical_code_review_comments: lut.py apply_lut_trilinear: the shape validation branch (lines 95-99) is dead logic — the first condition is written with mixed chained comparisons and effectively always passes, so a malformed LUT would raise deep inside the indexing instead of raising the intended ValueError. Simplify to `if lut.ndim != 4 or lut.shape[3] != 3 or not (lut.shape[0]==lut.shape[1]==lut.shape[2]): raise ValueError(...)`.
server.py upload_lut writes the file to disk BEFORE verifying the preset exists, guaranteeing an orphan on a bad pid; also the previous lut file is never removed.

parse_cube_file silently ignores unparseable non-keyword lines (`continue`), so a file with the right entry count but garbage interleaved could parse; acceptable but the entry-count check is the only real guard.
finalize_session inlines the LUT load; it is correctly wrapped in try/except and compose_print runs via asyncio.to_thread (good — 1200x1800 trilinear does not block the loop).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of LUT flows tested (admin upload/badge/remove, kiosk WebGL canvas)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily attached identity + teal/orange .cube LUTs to preset 'warm' and ran 5 finalize sessions on the active demo event. All LUTs detached afterwards (verified: no seeded preset has lut_path) and the 30 leaked .cube files in /app/storage/assets/luts were deleted.
test_credentials: Admin password snapbooth, kiosk PIN 1234 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) — both valid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite is 65 tests: backend_test.py (48), test_lut_parity.py (5, needs scipy installed), test_lut_api.py (12, new). pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope, so all LUT API tests must stay in the single class TestLutFeature to avoid cross-worker races on the shared 'warm' preset. active_event fixture returns a bundle — event id is at active_event['event']['id']. GET /api/presets/{pid}/lut.png returns 405 for HEAD; edge proxy strips the public Cache-Control. Kiosk filter step is reachable headless without a camera (getUserMedia failure only toasts), so kiosk-lut-canvas + WebGL shader compile can be asserted; real image parity is proven by the numpy shader simulation in test_lut_parity.py.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found in the LUT feature. Two housekeeping bugs: (1) upload/delete LUT endpoints do not verify the preset exists before mutating storage (update_one matched_count ignored), producing orphan files and misleading 200s; (2) old .cube files are never unlinked on replace/delete, leaking disk (3.9MB after 30 uploads). The reported 'scipy installed' precondition was false — scipy was missing, so test_trilinear_matches_scipy_reference was skipping; after `pip install scipy` it passes (mean drift < 0.6, max <= 2 counts).
